'''bounty hunter6 Spaceport Speeders''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bounty hunter6]]
* '''Published:''' 15 January 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Mos Eisley|Premiere-L-tatooinemoseisley.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Mos Eisley
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 TME hunter6 LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Leia (V) (Virtual Set 3), For Luck (V) (Virtual Set 3): not in GEMP)

Beatdowns

== Notes ==

* Qty 58 as published: the Interrupts header says 30 but the list adds to 28; the other headers match.
* No objective. The draft parser dropped 'Spaceport Speeders x12' and read the 'EPPS'/'Non Epps' sub-headers as cards.
* Posted under '- EPPS –': Chewie, Han, Luke, Obi Wan, Lando dested Chewie With Blaster Rifle, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Luke With Lightsaber, Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Lando With Vibro-Ax.
* Luke’s X-34 Landspeeder x8 is a unique card; dested as posted.
* Posted Leia’s Blaster dested Leia's Blaster Rifle (to match Leia (V)); Tunnel Vision Combo dested Control & Tunnel Vision; Gift of a Mentor dested Gift Of The Mentor.
* Original-era (V): Leia (V) and For Luck (V) (Virtual Set 3).

== Strategy ==

Spaceport Speeders – Draw 3 Destiny’s for Luke’s Speeder, activate that force (up to 40 force first turn easy)…this deck is made for really quick beat downs…makes it hard for DS to survive…Use Tunnel Vision to get out characters…Simply put but really good…no objective pile that hasn’t lost many games

I know the more creative decks can be hard to rate...
